sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Say this before advice, dosage, refills, or interactions so staff know the medicine is part of your daily routine.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Tôi uống thuốc này mỗi ngày as one clean sentence; the symptom, medicine, affected area, or translated note can carry the exact detail. Show the symptom, medicine, location, or helper contact if you can.

sections.body: Best in a pharmacy, clinic, or hotel desk, before the explanation gets long. Keep the symptom, medicine, affected area, or translated note close for the follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Show the package, photo, or prescription if you can. The medicine name matters more than a long explanation.
